paragraphs.text: The Vile Cauldron is a magical artifact found on the plane of Eldraine .

The Vile Cauldron appears to be a large metal cauldron containing a green bubbling liquid that releases green vapors or steam. It can boil down the essence of whatever is put within it, including people. It was originally owned by Talion , who gave it to Agatha in exchange for her and her sisters' assistance in casting the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion . Months after receiving it, she enchanted the woodsman Peter , turning him into the Wolf Knight. With Peter's help, she captured Syr Imodane and prepared to cook her into a stew. However, Kellan slew the witch by pushing her into her cauldron and boiling her alive. Kellan took ownership of the Cauldron after that and later returned it to Talion.
